mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the closed-world permission matrix allows the model to invent unauthorized (role, operation) pairs, violating the least-privilege constraint. The assertion checks that only allowed pairings exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthorizedPermission { some u: User | u.user_role = HospitalAdministrator and (u.user_role -> ReadRecord) in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the uniqueness constraint on note IDs permits the model to create two different notes with the same ID, violating the append-only invariant (notes cannot be overwritten).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateNoteId { some disj n1, n2: ClinicalNote | n1.note_id = n2.note_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the requirement that every added note has a corresponding audit entry allows notes to exist without audit records, violating the completeness and one-per-access invariants.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuditForNote { some n: ClinicalNote | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.note_id = n.note_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the care-team membership check allows clinical users to read records without being on the care team, violating the ownership-based access control invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthorizedRecordRead { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.access_type = ReadRecord and isClinicalRole[ae.user_role] and ae.outcome = Permitted and no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.clinician = ae.user and ctm.status = Active }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the snapshot integrity constraint allows audit entries to record incorrect user roles, violating the attribution-correctness invariant that user snapshots match actual user data.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_IncorrectRoleSnapshot { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.user_role != ae.user.user_role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the unified denial-response constraint allows different error responses for different denial reasons (not-found vs. not-authorized), enabling information leakage about whether a patient exists.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DistinguishableErrors { some ae: AuditEntry | (ae.outcome = Denied or ae.outcome = NotFoundOrDenied) and ae.access_type not in ReadRecord + AddNote }
